features: 【Professional Video Editing Control】This ULANZI D100H video editing keyboard features a premium aluminum alloy knob with an anti-slip texture and motor vibration feedback, delivering precise parameter adjustment for video color grading, timeline editing, and photo retouching—perfect video editing equipment for accurate and efficient creative work. (The D100H video editing keyboard is only compatible with Windows 10+ and macOS 12+; it does not support other devices and is not compatible with iPad/iPhone mobile devices.)

【Wide Software Compatibility】The ULANZI D100H video editing keyboard fully supports mainstream video & photo editing software, compatible with CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Photoshop/Lightroom Classic; ideal video editing equipment compatible with macOS 12+ and Windows 10+, no extra configuration needed for one-click use.

【Online Working Modes & Customization】The ULANZI D100H video editing keyboard supports online mode (Ulanzi Studio); 7 customizable buttons + 1 multi-functional knob enable one-hand blind operation, and you can set shortcut combinations for video editing, office, and multimedia control freely.

【Bluetooth 5.1 Wireless Connection】The ULANZI D100H video editing keyboard is equipped with Bluetooth 5.1 technology, with a transmission distance up to 10 m, and can connect/switch 3 devices (PC, Mac, iPad) instantly and simultaneously; built-in 1000mAh rechargeable battery, 2.5 hours full charge for 2.5 hours continuous use, low standby power consumption (200uA) for long-time standby. (Only Bluetooth 5.1 Connection; the USB port is only used for charging, not dual-mode connection)

【All-in-One Creative Assistant】The ULANZI D100H video editing keyboard is not only a professional video editing controller for creators, but also a practical video editing accessory for daily office use—supports system volume/brightness adjustment, music control, copy/paste/undo; compatible with ULANZI D200 series to form a "key+knob" creative solution, and also supports ULANZI light control.
